sources.title: Qwen3 Large Model Fine-Tuning in Practice: Medical Reasoning Dialogue
sources.snippet: In this article, we will fine-tune the Qwen3-1.7b model on the delicate_medical_r1_data dataset, enabling the fine-tuned Qwen3 to provide reasoning-based responses to medical questions. The training utilizes tools like transformers and datasets, with SwanLab for monitoring and evaluating model performance.
